# clearml Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "clearml" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) ClearML access key. Defaults to CLEARML_ACCESS_KEY when unset.
- `api_url` (String) ClearML API URL. Defaults to https://api.clear.ml.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) ClearML secret key. Defaults to CLEARML_SECRET_KEY when unset.
